warnings: Defence-specific applications need independent proof beyond broad aerospace supplier evidence.
Confirm the legal entity and the clinical, regulatory, and manufacturing maturity of each therapeutic program; do not restate curative potential as an achieved outcome.
Keep waste-reduction, recovery, and production claims attributed to the company or project; verify permits, geology, and current operating scale for each deployment.
Confirm the exact legal entity, contracting department, deployed asset scope, and which performance results have independent engineering validation.
The public legal name differs from the operating brand; independently verify Glacier throughput, uptime, marine permitting, and environmental effects at deployment scale.
Separate Canadian capacity from U.S. facilities and keep recovery, water-use, and shipment claims attributed until independently measured at commercial scale.
Distinguish Burnaby R&D, Candiac production, licensed engineering, and actual commercial output; public-issuer forecasts remain forward-looking.
Verify Health Canada and other regulatory status, supported indications, clinical evidence, manufacturing volume, and service model; the official site notes XoMotion is not FDA-cleared.
Confirm current production capacity, qualification data, IP ownership, and the division of Canadian and Washington operations before assigning sovereign-manufacturing relevance.
